description: A girl welcoming the player to her club: all of SERIFU/NYUBU.BIN (base 0x80197000; game-internals 6q), 91 of 93 strings; the two '‥‥‥‥。' pauses stay. Eight sections from KANGEI.EXN's tables at 0x80139950 (`tools/geko_sections.py --nyubu`): 0 Shiori (parts by club: any club, baseball, soccer, other; she greets a new member or he finds her there), 1 Yuina, 2 Ayako (Art Club / Band), 3 Mio, 4 Yukari (Tennis), 5 Nozomi (swim team), 6 Saki (baseball / soccer manager), 7 the default case for girl ids 7 and up (a basketball-team line). Codes: 00 player, 01 girl, 0C/0D 'Oh, {P}' plus her line in one box. The player's lines that address her end the first line on {G} with an even-length lead-in ('Hi, {G}', 'Oh, {G}') so odd-length names don't show their pair padding before a comma. Verified in DuckStation with tools/emu/force_club_welcome.py (main state 0x60, hidden emulator; docs/testing.md 'Club welcome'): every section; Shiori's baseball, soccer and general parts (with a club set: her background is looked up by club and hangs with none, unpatched too); Yuina, Ayako's Art Club and Band, Mio, Yukari, Nozomi, Saki's soccer part, and section 7 via girl 10. Checked only statically: the other parts (the 'already there' variants of some girls, Saki's baseball part, Yuina's 'you forced me' part), and the natural trigger.
